description: Lambda functions must have X-Ray tracing enabled

requirements.description: Lambda function has no tracing configuration specified
requirements.rationale: Per the AWS Lambda Developer Guide, when no tracing configuration is set, Lambda defaults to PassThrough behavior, which does not record trace segments for the function. The rule requires X-Ray active tracing to be explicitly enabled.

requirements.description: Lambda function has tracing configuration with mode set to Active
requirements.rationale: Active mode causes Lambda to automatically create trace segments for function invocations and send them to X-Ray, satisfying the requirement that X-Ray tracing be enabled.

requirements.description: Lambda function has tracing configuration with mode set to PassThrough
requirements.rationale: PassThrough mode only propagates tracing context to downstream services and does not cause Lambda itself to record trace segments. This does not satisfy the requirement that X-Ray tracing be enabled for the function.

requirements.description: Lambda function has tracing configuration present but the mode value is missing or empty
requirements.rationale: Without a mode value of Active explicitly set, the function does not have active X-Ray tracing enabled. An empty or missing mode falls back to default behavior (PassThrough), which is non-compliant.

requirements.description: Lambda function has tracing mode set to an unrecognized value
requirements.rationale: Only Active mode satisfies the rule. Any value other than Active (including invalid or unrecognized values) means the function does not have X-Ray active tracing enabled.

requirements.description: Lambda function tracing mode value depends on an unresolvable condition
requirements.rationale: When the tracing mode value cannot be determined at analysis time, the rule cannot assert non-compliance. To avoid false positives, the rule should not flag in this case.

requirements.description: Lambda function's tracing configuration block is conditionally included via an unresolvable condition
requirements.rationale: When it cannot be determined at analysis time whether the tracing configuration is present, the rule cannot assert non-compliance. To avoid false positives, the rule should not flag.

requirements.description: Lambda function has no tracing configuration regardless of the event source type or runtime/package format used
requirements.rationale: Per resolved decision, the rule applies uniformly to all Lambda functions regardless of whether their event sources support X-Ray tracing (e.g., MSK, self-managed Kafka, Amazon MQ, DocumentDB) or their packaging format. The rule does not exclude functions based on event source compatibility.

requirements.description: AWS::Serverless::Function inherits Tracing from the template's Globals.Function section
requirements.rationale: SAM applies Globals.Function.Tracing to every AWS::Serverless::Function in the template, and a value on the function itself takes precedence. A function with no Tracing property of its own is still compliant when Globals.Function.Tracing is Active, so evaluating only the resource properties produces false positives.
